title: 第一卷 第13章 三件至宝第一卷 第14章 唐门叛徒
slug: 师叔你的法宝太不正经了
content_zh:
;;
等李寒舟从屋内走出来的时候，桌子上摆的满满的都是好菜。
李寒舟今天带回来不少的好吃的，云千竹和石命两个小家伙忙活了半天，做了这一桌子。
柳东岳也是很久都没有看到这么丰盛的饭菜了。
三个人口水欲滴。
但是李寒舟还没上桌，他们自然是不能先动筷子。
“吃吧。”李寒舟坐上来，开口说完，掰下来一个鸡腿放到了云千竹的碗里。
“师叔先吃。”云千竹赶紧将鸡腿给夹了回来。
在云千竹看来，这些好东西都是师叔在外面努力弄回来的，肯定很辛苦，不管是赌博还是怎么得来的，理应李寒舟先吃。
“好好。”李寒舟笑了笑。
云千竹这个小丫头虽然年纪小，但是真的很懂事。
李寒舟拿起鸡腿咬了一口。
云千竹和石命两人的厨艺有限，做出来的菜没那么好吃，但好在是食材不错，也不难吃，起码比李寒舟刚穿越来天天吃菜叶子强。
看着手里咬了一口的鸡腿，李寒舟突发奇想拿出了储物袋。
“储物袋！”
看到储物袋，柳东岳眼睛一亮！
这东西是好东西啊，有的时候看到那些大宗门的弟子身上有这样的好东西，柳东岳也是眼馋。
“师叔能炼制出储物袋了？”柳东岳着急地问。
“嗯，算是成功了。”李寒舟将手中的鸡腿轻轻放到了储物袋的袋口，然后储物袋中冒出一道黑烟，直接就将那鸡腿给吞噬进去了。
“成功了。”李寒舟眼睛一亮。

“哎，不是，师叔你等等。”柳东岳赶紧摆摆手。
“我也见过别人的储物袋，人家都是冒出青烟，将东西收进去，怎么师叔你的储物袋冒的是黑烟？”
柳东岳想到了自己冒绿光的七宝葫芦，总觉得李寒舟炼制的储物袋有些不对劲。
“你那七宝葫芦就是个意外，但是这是个储物袋，这东西又没有什么攻击力，怎么可能有什么不对劲的地方，不就是颜色不同吗？”李寒舟笑着说道：“你不信我把刚放进去的鸡腿拿出来给你看看。”
说完，李寒舟掌心一股灵力汇聚，然后神魂进入到储物袋中。
就要将那个鸡腿给拿出来证明一下。
然而……
没有！
“我鸡腿呢？”李寒舟一愣。
自己的鸡腿不见了？
然而此刻在李寒舟的储物袋中放着一个奇怪的东西。
李寒舟不记得自己的储物袋里放过这种东西啊，他手中光芒一闪，黑烟漫过，在李寒舟的手中就出现了一朵复杂的莲花模样的东西。
入手冰凉，给人一种幽森的气息，并且上面的零件精细得令人发指。
沉甸甸的，弥漫着一股淡淡的杀气。
这东西一出现，直接让在场几个人都震惊了。
“什么玩意？我鸡腿呢？”李寒舟懵逼了。
自己的鸡腿不见了，结果出现了这么个玩意。
“师叔！”柳东岳猛地站起身，下意识的后退两步，一脸惊恐地说道：“这是唐门第一杀器，千命鬼莲！你是从哪弄来的，这玩意整个唐门也就一个，传闻是唐门的镇宗之宝之一，怎么会在师叔你手里？”
“唐门的镇宗之宝？”李寒舟打量着手里的玩意，他也不知道这东西怎么会在他的储物袋里。
“师叔……”云千竹眼巴巴地看着李寒舟：“你突然这么有钱，是把唐门给偷了吗？”

“师妹，你太看得起师叔了。”石命则是摇摇头表示不相信。
李寒舟没有说话，他将这个千命鬼莲给放到了一边，然后随手在桌子上拿起一个碗，将碗给放到了储物袋里。
果不其然，碗进入储物袋之后又消失不见了。
然而下一刻，李寒舟从储物袋里又拿出来一个丹炉。
整个丹炉上缠绕着青龙，非常的霸气，其中还蕴含着丹香。

When Li Hanzhou came out of the house, the table was filled with delicious dishes.
Li Hanzhou brought back a lot of delicious food today, and Yun Qianzhu and Shi Ming worked hard for a long time to make this table.
Liu Dongyue has not seen such a sumptuous meal for a long time.
The three of them were all mouth watering.
But Li Hanzhou hadn't served the food yet, so naturally they couldn't use their chopsticks first.
"Eat it." Li Hanzhou sat up and after speaking, broke off a chicken leg and put it in Yun Qianzhu's bowl.
"Uncle, eat first." Yun Qianzhu quickly took the chicken legs back.
In Yun Qianzhu's view, these good things were obtained by his uncle's hard work outside. It must have been very hard. Whether it was obtained through gambling or how, Li Hanzhou should eat it first.
"Okay." Li Hanzhou smiled.
Although this little girl Yun Qianzhu is young, she is really sensible.
Li Hanzhou picked up the chicken leg and took a bite.
Yun Qianzhu and Shi Ming's cooking skills were limited, so the dishes they cooked were not that delicious, but fortunately the ingredients were good and not unpalatable. At least it was better than when Li Hanzhou had just traveled through time and ate vegetables and leaves every day.
Looking at the chicken leg he took a bite of, Li Hanzhou took out the storage bag on a whim.
"Storage bag!"
Liu Dongyue's eyes lit up when he saw the storage bag!
This thing is a good thing. Sometimes when he sees the disciples of the big sects having such good things, Liu Dongyue is also greedy.
"Uncle Master, can you refine a storage bag?" Liu Dongyue asked anxiously.
"Well, it's a success." Li Hanzhou gently placed the chicken drumstick in his hand into the opening of the storage bag, and then a black smoke came out of the storage bag and swallowed the drumstick directly.
"Successful." Li Hanzhou's eyes lit up.
"Hey, no, uncle, please wait." Liu Dongyue quickly waved his hand.
"I have also seen other people's storage bags. They always emit green smoke when they put things in them. Why is it that, uncle, your storage bag is emitting black smoke?"
Liu Dongyue thought of his seven-treasure gourd that glowed green, and felt that something was wrong with the storage bag made by Li Hanzhou.
"Your Seven Treasure Gourd was an accident, but it is a storage bag and it has no offensive power. How could there be anything wrong? Isn't it just a different color?" Li Hanzhou said with a smile: "If you don't believe me, I will take out the chicken legs I just put in and show you."
After speaking, a spiritual power gathered in Li Hanzhou's palm, and then his spirit entered the storage bag.
I need to take out that chicken leg to prove it.
However...
No!
"Where are my chicken legs?" Li Hanzhou was stunned.
Your chicken legs are missing?
However, there was a strange thing in Li Hanzhou's storage bag at this moment.
Li Hanzhou didn't remember putting such a thing in his storage bag. Light flashed in his hand, black smoke passed through, and something like a complicated lotus appeared in Li Hanzhou's hand.
It's cold to the touch, giving it a spooky feel, and the parts on it are incredibly delicate.
It was heavy and filled with a faint murderous aura.
As soon as this thing appeared, everyone present was shocked.
"What the hell? Where are my chicken legs?" Li Hanzhou was confused.
My chicken legs disappeared, and this thing appeared.
"Uncle Master!" Liu Dongyue stood up suddenly, subconsciously took two steps back, and said with a look of horror: "This is the number one killer weapon of the Tang Sect, the Thousand-Life Ghost Lotus! Where did you get it? There is only one of these in the entire Tang Sect. It is rumored to be one of the Tang Sect's sect-suppressing treasures. How come it is in your hands, Uncle Master?"
"The treasure of the Tang Sect?" Li Hanzhou looked at the thing in his hand. He didn't know why it was in his storage bag.
"Uncle Master..." Yun Qianzhu looked at Li Hanzhou helplessly: "You are suddenly so rich, have you stolen the Tang Sect?"
"Junior sister, you think too highly of uncle." Shi Ming shook his head in disbelief.
Li Hanzhou didn't sayAfter saying that, he put the Thousand-Life Ghost Lotus aside, then picked up a bowl on the table and put the bowl into the storage bag.
Sure enough, the bowl disappeared after entering the storage bag.
However, the next moment, Li Hanzhou took out another pill furnace from his storage bag.
The entire alchemy furnace is wrapped with a green dragon, which is very domineering and contains the fragrance of alchemy.
